### **Are you good at building rewarding professional relationships?**


If yes, then this is the right job for you.  

  



As a Front Line Sales employee in Bancassurance channel, you will network with assigned channel partner teams to build win\-win business relationship and ensure high performance by selling life insurance products.


### **What are we looking for?**


Integrity and passion to perform are the two most important traits that will define your success in this role. In addition, good verbal \& written communication and ability to influence are a must.


### **What does the job entail?**


It is a field job. You will have to travel within the assigned location to meet channel partner teams and customers.


You will be evaluated on your ability to meet the business targets (Top line, Persistency, Product mix) by collaborating with and driving channel partners.


You will also accompany the channel partner teams on pre and post sales such as claim settlement.


HDFC Life believes in technology driven sales and you will learn new technology/Mobility enhancements, to comply with the Sales Management Process.


As a business professional you will uphold organizational values in every action and ensure business ethics and integrity. You are expected to be compliant to regulatory and statutory regulations.


### **About the channel**


Bancassurance is the largest sales channel of HDFC Life which includes selling life insurance through Bancassurance partners like HDFC Bank.


With its vision to be the highest performing Bancassurance channel in the industry, the team has its presence in 400\+ locations in the country.


### **Essential Qualification**


Age: 21 \- 38 years


Education: Graduation in any stream


Minimum Sales Experience: 6 months to 4 years

**USI Executive Assistant \- Senior Services Support Associate –** 
**Deloitte Support Services India Private Limited**
 Join our team of dedicated enabling area professionals in Deloitte US’ organization in India (USI) who support global teams.
   

  

 We are looking to recruit outstanding individuals to become a pivotal part of our Executive Assistant Team within Finance \& Shared Services in our Hyderabad office. Ingenuity, resilience, and integrity, with an ability to use your own initiative to resolve problems quickly will be key to success in this role.

 As Executive Assistants seeking new challenges, you will have access to a comprehensive support and training package designed to equip you with the skills and competence that will be invaluable to you if you wish to explore a career as either an Executive Assistant or other roles within Deloitte. **Responsibilities of the role include:**

* Travel Arrangements: Planning and booking travel, including flights, accommodations, and itineraries, while ensuring adherence to travel policies and budget considerations. Manages travel requests, approvals and complex itineraries

* Good listener with a calm manner, and the ability to ask effective questions

* Excellent customer service skills, and a good telephone manner
* Team player who is reliable and respects others, with a desire and drive to meet and exceed team targets

title: AVP, CoreTech Governance & Risk
description:
**Role Title: AVP, CoreTech Governance and Risk (L10\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 The AVP, CoreTech Governance Lead is part of the CoreTech Governance and Risk organization and operates as a First Line of Defense (1LOD) function. This role is responsible for driving enterprise\-wide adherence to CRI, NIST, internal technology standards, and applicable regulatory requirements. The team partners closely with Technology, Audit, Compliance, Risk, and business stakeholders to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate risks across Synchrony’s global technology infrastructure, while promoting strong governance, accountability, and risk management practices.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 AVP, CoreTech Governance \& Risk, will lead governance, risk, and compliance activities related to regulatory requirements. This role is accountable for timely issue remediation, supporting audits and regulatory examinations, managing policy lifecycles, driving risk acceptance processes, and overseeing exceptions management. The AVP collaborates cross\-functionally to ensure Synchrony mitigates risks, and provides clear, auditable documentation for internal and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Issue Management: Ensure timely identification, tracking, remediation, and closure of CoreTech related issues by collaborating with Technology teams, Issue Management, Second Line of Defense (2LOD), and Internal Audit.
* Audit and Examination Support: Coordinate internal meetings, evidence collection, preparation, and responses to auditors, regulators, and Internal Audit teams.
* Risk Acceptance Oversight: Lead risk acceptance activities by managing documentation, obtaining approvals, and ensuring alignment with company policies.
* Policy Lifecycle Management: Manage the development, review, approval, and publication of CoreTech related policies, standards, and procedures.
* Exception Management: Oversee the intake, validation, documentation, and approval of exception requests, ensuring compliance with governance requirements.
* Metrics and Reporting: Provide regular status updates and metrics on issue remediation, risk acceptance activities, exceptions, and audit readiness to senior leadership and stakeholders.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Strong knowledge of IT controls.
* Experience managing governance and risk programs in a regulated environment.
* Proven project management and coordination skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams including technology, audit, and risk.
* Detail\-oriented with strong organizational and analytical abilities.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Prior experience supporting internal and external audits.
* Understanding of risk acceptance frameworks and process automation tools.
* Familiarity with enterprise policy management systems.
* Experience working in financial services or consumer finance industries.


**Eligibility Criteria**
 Bachelor's degree with 6\+ years of 1st Line of Defense experience Or in lieu of a degree 8\+ years of experience required.
   

  

**Work Timings**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility and Choice offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs. Please discuss this with the hiring manager for more details.
   

  

**For Internal Applicants**
* Understand the mandatory skills required for the role before applying.
* Inform your manager and HRM before applying through Workday.
* Ensure your professional profile (education, prior experience, and skills) is up\-to\-date and upload your latest resume (Word or PDF).
* Must not be under any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP).
* Eligibility: L9 employees must have completed 12 months in the organization and current role/level.
* L9\+ employees must have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role/level.

title: Senior Manager, Technical Services
description:
**Description**


**Who is USP?**


The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.


At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.


USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.


**Brief Job Overview**


The Sr. Manager, Technical Services Support (India) is a strategic people leadership role responsible for overseeing the India\-based Technical Services team and supporting the continued growth and evolution of USP's global Technical Services function. This position plays a critical role in ensuring the delivery of high\-quality scientific product/service inquiry support, operational excellence, and an exceptional customer experience while fostering a high\-performing, customer\-centric culture.


The role operates within a matrixed leadership structure, functionally reporting to the Senior Director, Customer Success \& Operations (US\-based) and administratively reporting to the Director, Scientific Affairs (India\-based). The incumbent will provide direct people leadership and administrative oversight for the India\-based Technical Services team while partnering closely with the US\-based Senior Manager, Technical Services Operations, who provides functional direction related to service delivery processes, performance standards, and inquiry management activities.


As USP continues to expand its global service delivery capabilities, this role is expected to evolve in scope and strategic impact, contributing to organizational scaling efforts, talent development, operational excellence initiatives, knowledge management, process optimization, workforce planning, and the advancement of global scientific and product/service support capabilities.


The Sr. Manager will collaborate extensively with stakeholders across Customer Success \& Operations, Strategic Customer Development, Scientific Affairs, Quality Assurance, Customer Service, Reference Material Support, Reference Standards Technical Operations, Reference Standards Production, Distribution, Reference Standards Evaluation, Legal, Documentary Standards and Compendial Policy, Global Biologics, and other cross\-functional teams located in both the United States and India.


The primary working shift for this position is 2:00 PM – 10:30 PM IST.


**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**


As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.


Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.


The Sr. Manager, Technical Services Support role has the following responsibilities:


**Key Responsibilities**


**People Leadership \& Team Management**


* Provide leadership, guidance, direction, and administrative oversight to the India\-based Technical Services team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer\-centricity.
* Integrate employee engagement principles into daily leadership practices to cultivate a high\-performing, motivated, and inclusive team environment, led by example through visible leadership and active coaching.
* Manage all aspects of employee performance, including goal setting, communicating job expectations, performance evaluations, coaching, mentoring, career development, recognition, corrective action, and succession planning.
* Partner with the Customer Success and Operations leadership team to support workforce planning, talent acquisition, onboarding, employee retention, and capability development initiatives as the Technical Services organization continues to evolve and expand.
* Ensure team members have access to the appropriate resources, tools, training, and support required to effectively perform their responsibilities.

**Service Delivery \& Operational Excellence**


* Partner closely with the Senior Manager, Technical Services Operations, who provides the functional strategy and strategic direction for the Global Technical Services, to effectively execute and operationalize the Technical Services operating model within India.
* Translate established strategies, processes, policies, procedures, training programs, and service delivery standards into consistent day\-to\-day execution, ensuring high\-quality, efficient, and scalable service delivery.
* Provide local operational leadership, monitor performance and adherence to standards, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement that strengthen team effectiveness, service quality, and overall customer experience.
* Ensure adherence to applicable USP Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Department Controlled Documents, Operational Manuals, quality requirements such as audit readiness, and regulatory expectations.
* Monitor team performance against established service levels, quality standards, productivity goals, and customer experience objectives, implementing corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives as needed.
* Utilize operational data, performance metrics, and customer feedback to identify trends, opportunities, and risks that support ongoing optimization of the Technical Services function.
* Support organizational initiatives focused on operational scalability, process harmonization, knowledge management, and service excellence.

**Scientific Inquiry Management \& Quality Oversight**


* Maintain a strong understanding of USP products, services, scientific resources, and customer support processes to effectively lead and support the team.
* Remain proficient in the functionality and use of Salesforce, including the Case Management Module and related service technologies.
* Conduct case quality reviews and quality assurance assessments for both US\- and India\-based Technical Services team members to ensure consistency, accuracy, and compliance with established standards.
* Support the development and maintenance of knowledge assets, best practices, training materials, and quality improvement initiatives that enhance inquiry resolution effectiveness.
* Serve as a first point of escalation and directly manage customer inquiries as needed based on business demands, inquiry complexity, volume fluctuations, or resource requirements.

**Cross\-Functional Partnership \& Strategic Support**


* Collaborate with Customer Success \& Operations, Scientific Affairs, Quality Assurance, Customer Service, Legal, Distribution, Global Science teams, and other cross\-functional stakeholders to support customer and organizational objectives.
* Facilitate effective communication and alignment between India\-based team members and global stakeholders, helping to ensure consistency in service delivery and execution.
* Contribute to the continued evolution of USP's global Technical Services operating model by identifying opportunities to enhance team capabilities, operational effectiveness, and customer outcomes.
* Participate in special projects, strategic initiatives, organizational transformation efforts, and other duties as assigned, supporting the long\-term growth and maturity of the Technical Services function.

**Who is USP Looking For?**


The successful candidate will have a demonstrated understanding of our mission, commitment to excellence through inclusive and equitable behaviors and practices, ability to quickly build credibility with stakeholders, along with the following competencies and experience:


* Master's degree in chemistry or relevant scientific field
* Minimum of ten (12\) years of experience in the pharmaceutical field, which includes hands\-on experience and expertise in chromatography, spectroscopy, and other analytical testing methods.
* Minimum of 2 years of management experience.
* Must demonstrate a strong customer\-centric mindset with a consistent focus on delivering high\-quality service, responsiveness, and customer satisfaction in a regulated or technical environment.
* Must have experience translating scientific or technical expertise into effective customer support, issue resolution, and service excellence outcomes within cross\-functional teams.
* Must be willing to work in 2:00 PM – 10:30 PM IST shift.

**Additional Desired Preferences**


* Willingness to travel to USP–Rockville for initial training purposes for approximately 2–4 weeks
* Knowledge of USP standards\-setting processes, compendial terminology, USP Documentary Standards, and USP reference materials
* Familiarity with laboratory workflows and ability to interpret customer issues related to reference materials and analytical testing to support effective resolution
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage a high volume of work in a fast\-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail
* Strong organizational and problem\-solving skills with the ability to manage competing priorities effectively
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a matrixed, global team environment
* Ability to maintain composure, professionalism, and positive engagement in high\-pressure or time\-sensitive situations
* Willingness and ability to work flexible and/or extended hours when required to support global operations and customer needs
* Sufficient typing skills to support efficient case documentation and system usage
* Preferred but not required: experience using Salesforce CRM or similar case management systems

**Supervisory Responsibilities**


Will lead a team of 5 scientists responsible for managing customer inquiries related to USP Documentary Standards and USP Physical Materials.


**Benefits**


USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company\-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well\-being is protected.


Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.

description:
**About Citco:**

Citco is a global leader in fund services, corporate governance and related asset services with staff across 80 offices worldwide. With more than $1 trillion in assets under administration, we deliver end\-to\-end solutions and exceptional service to meet our clients’ needs.


For more information about Citco, please visit www.citco.com .


**About the Team \& Business Line:**

Fund Administration is Citco’s core business, and our alternative asset and accounting service is one of the industry’s most respected. Our continuous investment in learning and technology solutions means our people are equipped to deliver a seamless client experience.  



  

As part of the Real Assets Operations Skills Development team, you will help build accounting, technical and operational capabilities across our Real Assets business through training, onboarding and knowledge\-sharing initiatives.


  
**Your Role:**

* Develop, maintain and periodically update training materials, process guides and onboarding documentation in line with curriculum standards and guidance from the (Assistant) / Vice President and Subject Matter Experts.
* Translate operational procedures, process updates and system enhancements into practical training and knowledge\-sharing materials, ensuring alignment with approved policies and practices.
* Support the review and update of training content following process, system or regulatory changes, identifying and escalating content gaps where appropriate.
* Coordinate with Subject Matter Experts to arrange training sessions, gather content and follow up on agreed actions.
* Deliver onboarding, introductory and process\-level training covering operational procedures, recurring tasks, documentation standards and system navigation.
* Provide day\-to\-day onboarding support to new joiners, helping them navigate training materials, process documentation and operational resources.
* Maintain training records, attendance logs, feedback trackers, version control and completion monitoring, and support scheduling and invitations for training programmes.
* Maintain approved training and process documentation within designated knowledge management repositories, ensuring information remains accurate and accessible.
* Monitor recurring operational errors, training challenges and documentation gaps, and escalate recurring training needs, quality concerns and recommendations to the (Assistant) / Vice President.
* Maintain a proactive internal customer focus, provide practical support to trainees, reviewers and managers.
* Perform other duties as required to support the Company's business needs.

  
**About You:**

* Degree in Business, Finance or a related discipline desirable; part\-qualified or working towards an ACA, CA, ACCA, CPA or equivalent professional designation an advantage.
* Minimum 6 years of private and/or public accounting experience, ideally including exposure to Real Assets and Fund Accounting.
* Working understanding of SPV accounting, real estate structures, operational processes, reporting cycles and review expectations.
* Experience delivering onboarding and process\-level training and supporting structured knowledge transfer, with the ability to explain operational and system processes clearly.
* Experience developing, updating and maintaining training materials, process documentation and knowledge\-sharing resources to established standards.
* Well\-organised, with strong attention to detail in maintaining training records, version control, attendance and completion tracking.
* Ability to identify content gaps, recurring training needs and process inconsistencies and escalate them appropriately.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, facilitation and business writing skills, with the ability to collaborate with Subject Matter Experts, Operations teams and Learning \& Development; solid Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint skills, and exposure to fund accounting systems (Yardi and/or Investran an advantage).
A motivated, proactive self\-starter with a passion for supporting others, able to work independently, manage multiple priorities and collaborate across locations in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.  
* 

**Our Benefits**

Your wellbeing is of paramount importance to us, and central to our success. We provide a range of benefits, training and education support, and flexible working arrangements to help you achieve success in your career while balancing personal needs. Ask us about specific benefits in your location.


We embrace diversity, prioritizing the hiring of people from diverse backgrounds. Our inclusive culture is a source of pride and strength, fostering innovation and mutual respect.


Citco welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection.

**Role Overview**
-----------------


The Manager, Supply Chain Learning \& Organizational Excellence will play a key role in enabling the growth, effectiveness and long\-term capability of the Supply Chain organization at Amgen India. The role will work closely with site and global Supply Chain leadership to translate organizational priorities into coordinated execution, strengthen operating rhythms, support cross\-functional initiatives, and build the learning capabilities required for a high\-performing and compliant organization.


A significant focus of the role will be to establish, sustain and continuously mature the Supply Chain Learning \& Development program at Amgen India. The successful candidate will help evolve this capability toward a comprehensive Supply Chain Academy that enables structured onboarding, knowledge transfer, technical and functional capability development, and continuous learning across the organization.


This role requires a combination of strong program leadership, organizational effectiveness, learning operations, GxP knowledge and the ability to work across a complex global and cross\-functional environment.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Organizational Enablement \& Strategic Execution**

* Partner with Supply Chain leadership to translate strategic priorities into coordinated plans, actions, milestones and measurable outcomes.
* Establish and maintain effective operating rhythms across key organizational priorities, including leadership reviews, initiative tracking, decision follow\-up, risk management and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Provide structure and visibility across strategic initiatives by consolidating progress, identifying risks and interdependencies, and enabling timely escalation and decision\-making.
* Coordinate across Planning, Distribution, Enablement, Customer Service, Clinical Supply Chain and other in\-scope functions to connect priorities, process knowledge, capability requirements and organizational needs.
* Develop leadership\-ready materials, insights and progress updates that enable effective governance and informed decision\-making.
* Support organizational change, capability\-building and continuous\-improvement initiatives as the Amgen India Supply Chain organization grows and matures.

### **Learning \& Capability Development**

* Execute global GxP learning strategies, standards and frameworks for in\-scope global Supply Chain functions, adapting implementation to meet Amgen India organizational and site needs.
* Build, sustain and continuously improve the Supply Chain Learning \& Development program, establishing the foundations for an integrated Supply Chain Academy.
* Develop a structured capability\-development approach spanning onboarding, role\-based learning, technical and functional knowledge, leadership development, continuous learning and knowledge retention.
* Support the Supply Chain knowledge\-transfer plan for Amgen India onboarding, including transfer cadence, readiness assessments, risk identification, progress tracking and stakeholder coordination.
* Partner with functional leaders and subject matter experts to identify current and future capability requirements and translate them into scalable learning solutions and development pathways.
* Lead implementation and execution of Supply Chain training programs at the site level, ensuring alignment with GMP/GxP/GDP requirements, Amgen quality standards and applicable regulatory expectations.
* Establish measures to assess learning effectiveness, organizational capability and program maturity, using insights to continuously strengthen the learning strategy.

### **GxP Learning Operations \& Governance**

* Create, revise and maintain Training Assignment Profiles (TAPs), associated learning and assessment materials, SOPs, work instructions, job aids and other learning documentation using approved templates, systems and workflows.
* Ensure appropriate document ownership, version control, traceability, approvals and inspection readiness across learning materials.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for Supply Chain learning operations, including training intake, LMS processes, training assignments, completion tracking and day\-to\-day training activities.
* Support audits and regulatory inspections by preparing training reports, responding to training\-record requests and supporting direct interface with auditors or inspectors as assigned.
* Participate in the GxP Learning Community of Practice and collaborate with global learning partners to advance continuous improvement, change management, standardization and learning governance.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize and scale learning processes while maintaining compliance and quality.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Master’s degree and 8\-12 and relevant professional experience; OR
* Bachelor’s degree and significant relevant professional experience in Supply Chain, Learning \& Development, Quality, Operations, Organizational Effectiveness or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience working in a regulated pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device or similarly controlled environment.
* Experience supporting or leading cross\-functional programs involving multiple stakeholders, priorities and dependencies.
* Strong program and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple interconnected workstreams and provide clear visibility to leadership.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to synthesize complex information into concise, leadership\-ready communications.
* Strong stakeholder\-management and influencing skills with demonstrated effectiveness working across functions, organizational levels and geographies.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Ability to operate effectively in an evolving environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution.
* Continuous\-improvement mindset with an interest in building scalable, sustainable organizational capabilities.
* Experience within pharmaceutical or biotechnology Supply Chain
* Strong understanding of GxP/GMP/GDP requirements and their application to training, qualification and learning operations.
* Experience designing, implementing or scaling learning and capability\-development programs in a complex organization.
* Experience with LMS platforms, controlled documentation, training assignment processes and learning governance.
* Experience supporting knowledge transfer, organizational onboarding or establishment of new teams or capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to convert broad organizational priorities into structured execution plans and operating mechanisms.

**Working Expectations**
------------------------

* Collaborate extensively with colleagues and stakeholders across Amgen India and the global organization.
* Work across global time zones as required to support international teams and initiatives.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------


Success in this role will be reflected in a well\-connected and effectively operating Supply Chain organization, strong visibility and execution against key organizational priorities, and a sustainable learning ecosystem that enables employees to become proficient in their roles and continue developing throughout their careers.


Over time, the role will help establish an integrated Supply Chain Academy that preserves critical organizational knowledge, accelerates onboarding and proficiency, develops functional and leadership capabilities, and creates a culture of continuous learning across Amgen India Supply Chain.
